findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: contacts-enrich_work_email_batch_get, company_lists-create · Private data: contacts-enrich_work_email_batch, contacts-enrich_work_email_batch_get, contacts-enrich_custom, contacts-enrich_work_email, contacts-get_research_by_external_id, contacts-create_research, contacts-get_research, contacts-search, contact_lists-list, contact_lists-create, contact_lists-get, contact_lists-update, contact_lists-delete, contact_lists-get_contacts · Public sink: contacts-enrich_work_email_batch, contacts-enrich_work_email_batch_get, contacts-enrich_work_email · Destructive: companies-enrich_custom_batch, enrichment_runs-get, enrichment_templates-delete, monitors-delete, monitors-trigger, monitors-delete_action, contact_lists-create, contact_lists-delete, company_lists-delete, scoring-profile-delete, scoring-rule-delete, scoring-assignment-delete.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: contacts-enrich_work_email_batch_get, company_lists-create · Private data: contacts-enrich_work_email_batch, contacts-enrich_work_email_batch_get, contacts-enrich_custom, contacts-enrich_work_email, contacts-get_research_by_external_id, contacts-create_research, contacts-get_research, contacts-search, contact_lists-list, contact_lists-create, contact_lists-get, contact_lists-update, contact_lists-delete, contact_lists-get_contacts · Public sink: contacts-enrich_work_email_batch, contacts-enrich_work_email_batch_get, contacts-enrich_work_email · Destructive: companies-enrich_custom_batch, enrichment_runs-get, enrichment_templates-delete, monitors-delete, monitors-trigger, monitors-delete_action, contact_lists-create, contact_lists-delete, company_lists-delete, scoring-profile-delete, scoring-rule-delete, scoring-assignment-delete

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
